observations: Three blue plastic drums are visible, stacked on a paved sidewalk next to a road.
The drums are cylindrical, with black lids and some yellow text or markings on the side of one drum.
The drums appear to be used, with visible dirt, scuffs, and wear on the plastic.
The person standing beside the drums is wearing a white t-shirt with '98' on the back.
The setting is an outdoor urban area with cars, pedestrians, and debris on the road and sidewalk.
No brand or model markings are visible on the drums in any photo.
The drums are not labeled or marked for specific capacity or use.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
